_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the variant key, LeafCutter intron identifier and Ensembl gene ID.

biological_context.description: Tissue the QTL was measured in. AFGR used lymphoblastoid cell lines.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for lymphoblastoid cell line, as a handle into ontology_terms.

chr.description: Chromosome of the variant, prefixed with chr.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the nominal association p-value. Capped at 400 when the reported p-value is 0.

p_value.description: Nominal p-value of association between the variant and the splice junction, from the African-population meta-analysis.

effect_size.description: Regression coefficient (beta) of the alternate allele on intron excision.

posterior_inclusion_probability.description: Posterior inclusion probability that this variant is causal for the splice QTL.

log2FC.description: log2 fold change of intron excision associated with the alternate allele.

significant.description: Whether the variant–intron association passed the study's significance threshold.

intron_chr.description: Chromosome of the LeafCutter intron, prefixed with chr.

intron_start.description: Start of the LeafCutter intron, stored as a string.

intron_end.description: End of the LeafCutter intron, stored as a string.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this QTL was read from.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for regulation of RNA splicing, as a handle into ontology_terms.

accessible_via.filter_by_range: intron_start, intron_end, neg_log10_pvalue, effect_size, posterior_inclusion_probability, log2FC
accessible_via.simplified_return: class, method, label, source, neg_log10_pvalue, biological_context
